title: Console-bridge midweek sprint handoff - prep notes
content:
Purpose: quick sync with serving-runtime + infra leads to align on the console rollout dry run, hotfix patch, and telemetry changes. Keep to 30m. Low ceremony, bring blockers only.

When: Wed 11:00-11:30 (PT)
Attendees (ask to confirm): Bernard (me), Ellie (console ux/ops), Aisha (runtime product), Samir (infra), Kai (SRE if available), Lina (release eng)

Draft agenda (timeboxed)
- 11:00 - 11:03: Quick status: current sprint health (Bernard) — 3 bullets: release branch cut done, canary infra checks in progress, small regression seen in KV-cache metrics.
- 11:03 - 11:10: Console rollout dry-run plan (Ellie) — checkpoints, feature flags, smoke tests (links below).
- 11:10 - 11:17: Serving runtime hotfix (Aisha) — INF-2345 status, regressions repro steps, ETA for patch. Discuss fallback knob behavior.
- 11:17 - 11:23: Telemetry/observability changes (Samir) — new token-level latency tag, dashboard quick wins, retention impact.
- 11:23 - 11:28: Blockers & escalations — what needs an on-call or immediate PR review?
- 11:28 - 11:30: Quick action-item readout & owners (me)

Prep notes / things to gather before sync:
- Console smoke test checklist (Ellie) — update GH actions to include new env var test. PR 482 is gating.
- Repro for KV-cache regression: steps + sample payloads (Aisha) — attach logs from canary nodes (node-34, node-36).
- SLO telemetry diff: compare last 7d vs baseline (Samir) — highlight 95th p90 move for short (<64 tokens) requests.
- Canary rollout window: propose 3-hour window tomorrow morning 06:00-09:00 PT to minimize traffic.

Open questions / things to decide in meeting:
- If hotfix pushes latency +5%, do we prefer temporary routing to fallback-quantized model or roll back console change? pros/cons quick list.
- Can release-engineering run a parallel canary with reduced batching to validate impact? Lina to confirm.
- Do we enable the new token-level tag at 100% or staggered 25/50/100? (cost + storage implications)

Action items (template: ID - short desc - owner - due)
- AI-001 - Attach canary logs and repro payloads to INF-2345 - Aisha - 2026-03-10
- AI-002 - Add smoke test env-var to CI + link PR 482 to rollout checklist - Ellie - 2026-03-10
- AI-003 - Create a rapid dashboard with 95/99 latency bands for short seqs - Samir - 2026-03-11
- AI-004 - Confirm parallel canary feasibility and window with release eng - Lina - 2026-03-10
- AI-005 - Draft rollback vs fallback decision tree for dry-run playbook - Bernard - 2026-03-11

Notes to self (Bernard):
- Remind Lina about capacity reservation for parallel canary (we might need +2 p3d nodes)
- Bring up idea of short-token optimized kernel selection flag in meeting if time (this could be quick perf win)
- Check with legal/infra on telemetry retention limits if we increase token-level tags (cost forecast)

Quick links (for meeting)
- INF-2345 (ticket): repro steps + logs (linked above)
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/482 — add notes on blocking tests
- Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8709123 (dry-run playbook)

After-meeting follow-up template (to send in thread)
- 1) Short summary of decisions (3 bullets)
- 2) Action items with owners and due dates (copy from AI list)
- 3) Any PRs or tickets that need urgent review (call out reviewers)

Rough risks to mention quickly:
- Telemetry cost spike if we tag every token for large-volume customers — need sampling plan
- Parallel canary might double infra cost during window — ensure finance ok with transient bump
- If rollback is slow, customer-facing latency could remain elevated — prepare fallback messaging

Slack pings to prepare (who to ping pre-meeting):
- @lina-release (confirm capacity)
- @kai-sre (ask about on-call overlap)
- @ellis-ux (visual smoke test screenshots)

End of notes. Keep this as the working doc. Update AI statuses in-line as people report.
_notes: working personal scratchpad; intentionally rough. do not circulate as final without cleaning up language.
